LAW AND MOTION 301, RE: MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE CROSS-COMPLAINT. NO APPEARANCE WAS MADE BY ANY PARTY, COUNSEL, OR INTERESTED PERSON. THE COURT ADOPTS ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: THE UNOPPOSED MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE CROSS-COMPLAINT IS GRANTED FOR GOOD CAUSE SHOWN IN THE MOVING PAPERS. THE PROPOSED CROSS-COMPLAINT ATTACHED AS EXHIBIT 1 TO THE WILLIAMSON DECLARATION SHALL BE FILED BY JUNE 30, 2026. THE PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE AND SUBMIT TO DEPT. 301 A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER WHICH TRACKS VERBATIM THE SUBSTANTIVE PORTION OF THE COURT'S TENTATIVE RULING. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. CLERK: ROBERT WOODS. NOT REPORTED. (301/CVA)
